meta.title: Markdown to PDF
meta.description: Adds an export-to-PDF action for Markdown in the right sidebar's file tabs: open a .md file as a tab and the tab header shows a PDF button, the path label offers the same row on right-click, and a .md row in the workspace tree can be exported the same way. The PDF is written next to the source file with the same base name. Markdown rendered in the conversation is not covered. Rendering keeps headings, tables, task lists, footnotes, code blocks, images, frontmatter and TeX math, and uses system CJK fonts so Chinese and Japanese text prints correctly. Lists follow GitHub-flavored Markdown, so a list may start on the line right after a paragraph without a blank line between them. No pandoc, LaTeX or other command-line tool is required: math becomes MathML inside the plugin and the browser lays it out. The dsh-md2pdf page in Settings treats layout presets as editable templates: Lark (the default), an official document preset built on GB/T 9704-2012, and an academic paper preset built on GB/T 7713.2-2022; the two national-standard presets use three-line tables. Click a card to use a preset, click the blue bar under it to edit that preset's CSS, and create, reorder or delete presets from the same page. Saving asks for a name and confirms before replacing an existing one. An Open button beside the stylesheet path edits that preset's CSS in your own editor. Every preset shows a thumbnail of a really rendered page, and below the editor a larger preview shows the preset in use; an unmodified national-standard preset carries a badge. A preset change applies to the next export. Printing uses the DSH client's own Chromium in the Desktop app, with no extra browser; without a client it falls back to a local Chromium browser such as Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome. Page numbers are centered in the footer, and headers, footers, a PDF outline, a clickable table of contents, paper title fields and an explicit page break are available. Settings offers a test print, an engine refresh, diagnostics, and one-off page and document overrides for this window's later exports; neither the source file nor the preset changes. The browser fallback cannot print headers, footers, page numbers or an outline. Presets export to one JSON bundle for another machine, with conflicts confirmed first; each preset keeps its last 20 stylesheets and restores any of them. No file content leaves the machine, and nothing is uploaded. Turning the plugin off removes every control, the settings page and the md2pdf_export tool.
